# Argument lists

Generated by `sandbox-docs`, which calls the library ([`src/confinement.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/sandbox/blob/main/src/confinement.rs), [`src/docker.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/sandbox/blob/main/src/docker.rs)) for two layouts in a host directory `/srv/work`: the default run in `/srv/work/app`, and `--dir ../lib` from there. The command is `/bin/sh`, with no `TERM`, no `--ro` and no `--net`. Each block is what `b10x-sandbox --dry-run` prints: the program, then one argument per line. Under Docker the uid and gid are the caller's; the examples show 1000:1000.

`--net` removes `--unshare-net` (bubblewrap) or `--network none` (Docker) and nothing else. Each `--ro <PATH>` adds `--ro-bind <PATH> <PATH>` before the workspace, or `-v <PATH>:<PATH>:ro` before the writable volumes. `TERM` from the caller adds one `--setenv TERM` or `-e TERM=`.

## Bubblewrap, default layout

The working directory is bound at `/workspace` itself, so `/workspace` is not remounted read-only.

```text
bwrap
--unshare-user
--disable-userns
--unshare-ipc
--unshare-pid
--unshare-uts
--unshare-net
--die-with-parent
--ro-bind
/usr
/usr
--ro-bind-try
/bin
/bin
--ro-bind-try
/lib
/lib
--ro-bind-try
/lib64
/lib64
--proc
/proc
--dev
/dev
--tmpfs
/tmp
--tmpfs
/workspace
--bind
/srv/work/app
/workspace
--chdir
/workspace
--clearenv
--setenv
PATH
/usr/bin:/bin
--setenv
HOME
/tmp
--setenv
LANG
C.UTF-8
--setenv
LC_ALL
C.UTF-8
--setenv
TZ
UTC
--
/bin/sh
```

## Bubblewrap, mirrored layout

`/srv/work` becomes `/workspace`, a tmpfs holding one writable bind per directory, then remounted read-only so the parent itself takes no writes.

```text
bwrap
--unshare-user
--disable-userns
--unshare-ipc
--unshare-pid
--unshare-uts
--unshare-net
--die-with-parent
--ro-bind
/usr
/usr
--ro-bind-try
/bin
/bin
--ro-bind-try
/lib
/lib
--ro-bind-try
/lib64
/lib64
--proc
/proc
--dev
/dev
--tmpfs
/tmp
--tmpfs
/workspace
--bind
/srv/work/app
/workspace/app
--bind
/srv/work/lib
/workspace/lib
--remount-ro
/workspace
--chdir
/workspace/app
--clearenv
--setenv
PATH
/usr/bin:/bin
--setenv
HOME
/tmp
--setenv
LANG
C.UTF-8
--setenv
LC_ALL
C.UTF-8
--setenv
TZ
UTC
--
/bin/sh
```

## Docker, default layout

No tmpfs at `/workspace`: Docker refuses two mounts at one destination.

```text
docker
run
--rm
-i
--user
1000:1000
--network
none
--cap-drop
ALL
--security-opt
no-new-privileges
--read-only
--tmpfs
/tmp
-v
/srv/work/app:/workspace
-w
/workspace
-e
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
-e
HOME=/tmp
-e
LANG=C.UTF-8
-e
LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
-e
TZ=UTC
debian:stable-slim
/bin/sh
```

## Docker, mirrored layout

```text
docker
run
--rm
-i
--user
1000:1000
--network
none
--cap-drop
ALL
--security-opt
no-new-privileges
--read-only
--tmpfs
/tmp
--mount
type=tmpfs,destination=/workspace,tmpfs-mode=0555
-v
/srv/work/app:/workspace/app
-v
/srv/work/lib:/workspace/lib
-w
/workspace/app
-e
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
-e
HOME=/tmp
-e
LANG=C.UTF-8
-e
LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
-e
TZ=UTC
debian:stable-slim
/bin/sh
```
